The term "Resonance" describes the condition in a circuit when inductive reactance equals capacitive reactance.

Therefore, a series resonant circuit is an LC or LCR series circuit where XL equals XC.
Any series LCR circuit becomes a series resonant circuit when the frequency of the applied AC voltage causes XL to equal XC.
